## PRB1.2. En route service units {#prb1.2.-en-route-service-units .Heading-2-ER}

- Czech Republic recorded 2,473K actual service units in 2025, +4.8% compared to 2024 (2,360K).

- Actual 2025 service units were in line with the plan (2,474K).

- Actual 2025 service units are -15.8% below the actual 2019 level (2,936K).
